title: Niekie3202s Vanilla+
description: Vanilla+ is the best modpack to play the game as it is but with some mods that should be in regular vanilla minecraft!
body:
Vanilla+ is the best modpack to play the game as it is but with some mods that should be in regular vanilla minecraft!

This modpack includes some mods that should be in vanilla, like appleskin, inventory blur, Just Enough items and Shulker box Tooltip!

This modpack has a lot of optimization too, such as sodium, ModernFix and Chunky for more FPS.

I have included some resource packs and shaders to this pack, but feel free to decide what you use and what not! After all, that's what Minecraft is for.
